simple.meaning: חִזָּיוֹן (chizzâyôwn) is a Hebrew word meaning “a revelation , expectation by dream.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חִזָּיוֹן (H2384) appears 9 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 2 Samuel 7:17, with occurrences in 2 Samuel, Job, Isaiah, Joel, Zechariah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חִזָּיוֹן (H2384) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חִזָּיוֹן (H2384) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: חִזָּיוֹן (chizzâyôwn) / H2384 is traced through 2 Samuel 7:17, Job 4:13, Job 7:14, Job 20:8 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H2384. chizzayon חִזָּיוֺן noun masculine 2Sam 7:17 vision (on formation compare Lg BN 200 ) — absolute ׳ח 7:17 ; Isa 22:1 , 5 ; construct חֶזְיוֺן Job 20:8 ; 33:15 ; suffix חֶזְיֹנוֺ Zech 13:4 ; plural absolute חֶזְיֹנוֺת Job 7:14 ; Joel 3:1 , construct id . Job 4:13 ; — 1 vision , in the ecstatic state ח ׳ראה Joel 3:1 ; ח (א) ׳גּי valley of vision Isa 22:1 , 5 . 2 vision , in the night חֶזְיוֺנ(וֺת)לַיְלָה Job 4:13 ; 20:8 ; 33:15 ; || חֲלֹמוֺת 7:14 . 3 divine communication in a vision, oracle, prophecy: || דברים 2Sam 7:17 ( = חזון 1Chr 17:15 ); בְּהִנָּכְאֹתוֺ מֵחֶזְיֹנוֺ אִישׁ יֵבשׁוּ Zech 13:4 they will be ashamed, every one of his vision when he prophesieth .

occurrences.englishText: Nathan spoke to David all these words, and according to all this vision.
In thoughts from the visions of the night,
then you scare me with dreams,
He will fly away as a dream, and will not be found.
In a dream, in a vision of the night,
The burden of the valley of vision.
For it is a day of confusion, and of treading down, and of perplexity, from the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, in the valley of vision, a breaking down of the walls, and a crying to the mountains.”
It will happen in that day, that the prophets will each be ashamed of his vision, when he prophesies; neither will they wear a hairy mantle to deceive:
